results.title: Amurka ta zaftare yawon dakarunta da ke Birtaniya saboda barazanar Iran
results.content: Amurka ta soma kwashe dakarunta a sansanin Royal Air Force da ke Birtaniya saboda barazanar kai hari daga Iran.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Dakarun Rasha dubu 400 suka mutu a yaƙin ta da Ukraine - Bloomberg
results.content: Wani binciken shafin yaɗa labaran kasuwancin da ƙimiya Bloomberg ya ruwaito cewa akalla dakarun Rasha dubu 400 suka mutu a yakinta da Ukraine.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Mayaƙan Al-Shebab sun kashe mutum 8 a harin da suka kai gabashin Kenya
results.content: Aƙalla mutane takwas suka rasa rayukan su bayan da wasu mahara da ake zargin mayaƙan Al-Shabaab ne suka kai harin kwanton ɓauna kan wata tawagar jami’an tsaro da ma’aikatan gina hanya a arewa maso gabashin ƙasar Kenya.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: An yi cacar-baka tsakanin gwamnati da Obi kan Flamingos
results.content: An yi musayar yawu tsakanin Fadar gwamnatin Najeriya da ɗan takarar shugabancin ƙasar a zaɓe mai zuwa Peter Obi, wanda ya bayyana cewar jami’an hukumar ƙwallon ƙafar Najeriyar NFF sun hana shi gaisawa da tawagar matan ƙasar ta Flamingos a filin jiragen sama na Nnamdi Azikiwe da ke birnin Abuja.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Senegal ta lashe lambar Zinari ta huɗu a gasar matasa ta Olympics
results.content: Senegal mai masauƙin baƙin gasar wasannin motsa jikin matasa ta Olympics da ke gudana, ta lashe lambar yabon Zinare ta huɗu, bayan samun nasara kan Lithuania a wasan ƙarshe na gasar ƙwallon kwando.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Muna jiran hukuncin kotu da ya soke shugabancin ADC tsagin David Mark - Amupitan
results.content: Shugaban Hukumar zaɓen Najeriya INEC Farfesa Joash Amupitan, ya ce har yanzu ba a gabatar musu da hukuncin da kotu ta yanke kan shari’ar da ta rushe shugabancin jam’iyar ADC tsagin David Mark ba, don haka ba za su yi amfani da abubuwan da ke yawo a kafafen sada zumunta wajen aiwatar da umarnin ba.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Najeriya: An rantsar da alƙalai 375 don jagorantar kotunan ƙararrakin zaɓe
results.content: A Najeriya, ɓangaren shari’a ya rantsar da alƙalai 375 na kotuna na musamman da za su saurari ƙorafe-ƙorafen zaɓe gabanin zaɓen 2027. A jiya Litinin ce aka rantsar da waɗannan alƙalai a shelkwatar Hukumar manyan Alƙalai da lauyoyi ta ƙasar, wato Body of Benchers Complex da ke Abuja.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: A yau ne za a fara tattaunawar sulhu tsakanin Rasha da Ukraine a Abu Dhabi
results.content: A yau ne za a sake komawa teburin tattaunawa tsakanin Ukraine da Rasha, wanda Amurka ke jagoranta a Abu Dhabi, wacce ita ce tattaunawarsu ta farko cikin sama da watanni tara, a daidai lokacin da Washington ke matsa kaimi don ganin an kawo ƙarshen yaƙinsu na sama da shekaru 4.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Ƙungiyoyin matasa a Nijar sun buƙaci ɗaukar matakan yaƙi da ɗumamar yanayi
results.content: Yayin da aka fara babban taron yanayi na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya wato COP31 jiya Litinin a birnin Antalya na Turkiya, wanda shugabannin ƙasashe da wakilan ƙungiyoyi ke halarta, a Jamhuriyar Nijar ƙungiyoyin matasa sun ƙaddamar da gangamin wayar da kai kawunan jama’a kan matasalar ɗumamar yanayi.

results.title: Ƴan Najeriyan dubu 3 da 445 sun mutu a haɗurran ababen hawa cikin watanni 9- Rahoto
results.content: Hukumar kiyaye afkuwar haɗurra a Najeriya, ta ce rayukan ‘yan ƙasar dubu 3 da 445 ne suka salwanta daga Janairu zuwa Satumban shekarar bana, sanadiyyar haɗurran titi aƙalla dubu 7 da suka rutsa da su.

results.title: Kenya ta ƙwace methamphetamine na dala miliyan 27 a hannun masu safarar ƙwayoyi
results.content: Mahukunta a Kenya sun ƙwace sinadarin methamphetamine mai matuƙar haɗari da nauyinsa ya kai kilogram 454 kuma darajarsa ta tasamma dala miliyan 27 a wani gagarumin samame da suka ƙaddamar kan masu safarar miyagun ƙwayoyi a ƙasar ta gabashin Afrika.

results.title: Bakin haure akalla 20 sun mutu a tsibirin Crete na Girka
results.content: Aƙalla mutane 20 ne suka mutu a ƙarshen mako sakamakon kifewar mabanbantan kwale-kwalen da suke ciki yayi a tsuburin Crete, yayinda suke shirin tsallakawa zuwa ƙasar Girka ta teku, kamar yadda mahukuntan Tarayyar Turai suka tabbatar.

results.title: Jami'ar Ghana ta janye ƙarin kuɗin ɗakunan kwanan ɗalibai bayan boren jama'a
results.content: Bayan share tsawon kwanaki ana tarzoma a game da ƙarin kuɗin ɗakunan kwanan ɗalibai a jami'o'in Ghana, daga bisani hukumar gudanarwar Jami’ar ƙasar ta sanar da soke shirin yin ƙarin na kaso 15% a kan ɗakunan kwana ɗaliban a jami’ar, tare da sanar da buɗe ƙofar tattaunawa domin cimma yarjejeniya.

results.title: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta faro taron yanayi na COP31 a Turkiya
results.content: An faro babban taron yanayi na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya wato COP31 yau Litinin a birnin Antalya na Turkiya, taron da zai tattaro shugabanni da wakilcin kusan dukkanin ƙasashen duniya da nufin haɗa hannu don tunƙarar matsalar ta ɗumama ko kuma sauyin yanayi.

results.title: Rodrigo Mora ya ƙi amincewa da ƙarbar riga mai lamba 7 a Portugal
results.content: Matashin ɗan wasan Portugal Rodrigo Mora yaƙi amincewa da karɓar riga mai lamba 7 wadda tauraron ƙwallon ƙafar ƙasar Cristiano Ronaldo ya ajje bayan ritaya daga dokawa ƙasar shi ƙwallo a makon jiya.

results.title: Manchester United na duba yiwuwar korar Michael Carrick daga aikin horarwa
results.content: Akwai yiwuwar ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Manchester United ta sallami mai horarwa Michael Carrick, bayan jerin rashin nasarar da tawagar ƴan wasanshi ke fuskanta a kakar bana.

results.title: Tattaunawa da Zainab Muhammad kan nasarar Flamingos ta lashe kofin duniya
results.content: A Najeriya ana ci gaba da yabawa tawagar ƴan wasan Flamingos ta mata ƴan ƙasa da shekaru 17 da suka kafa tarihin zama tawaga ta farko da ta lashe kofin duniya karon farko a tarihin Nahiyar Afrika.
